description: UPDATE ... FROM and DELETE ... USING - Snowflake's join-update / join-delete: SET expressions and predicates resolve qualified references over target and source(s), source aliases and multi-source joins work, JOIN / LEFT JOIN shaped sources work, target aliases keep colliding column names apart (regression: wcs.cid = d.cid once resolved both sides to the target and hit every row), unmatched rows stay untouched, and the join-update participates in BEGIN/ROLLBACK. Converted 1:1 from dml/UpdateFromDeleteUsingTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE tgt (id INTEGER, amount INTEGER)
INSERT INTO tgt VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20), (3, 30)
CREATE TABLE src (id INTEGER, amount INTEGER)
INSERT INTO src VALUES (1, 100), (2, 200)
UPDATE tgt SET amount = src.amount FROM src WHERE tgt.id = src.id
SELECT amount FROM tgt ORDER BY id
